The following events took place in '''196 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Day of the Sepulchral Night]] occurred on [[Zelos II]], a rare solar eclipse.
*A shipwrecked [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] buried his treasure in [[Zelosian's Chine]].
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
*A class of students, including [[Roan Novachez]], begins their first term at the [[Coruscant Jedi Academy]].
{{Noncanonend}}
